formula_checks.name: equityRowValue
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Correct intrinsic option value, floored at zero, and share value for other grants; vesting value is not necessarily spendable cash.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.name: rowVestYear
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Assigns this year to an undated vest rather than identifying the missing date.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Keep vest year unknown until confirmed; an estimate must be labeled.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The first four digits of the date, or this year when there is none.
formula_checks.fixed_2026_10_25: FIXED 2026-10-25 (FIX-INCOME-B): each vest counts in the year its date names, read through the one reader of the vests (equityVests, yearMonthOf): rsuAnnual, equityCashFlow, equityVestWeights and taxableByCalendarMonth agree with equityByMonth; 2026 is $8,317.43 in March only; no date is "vest date not entered", in no year and no month.

formula_checks.name: equityCashFlow
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Grouping known vest values by actual year is correct, but an undated positive vest inherits rowVestYear’s invented current year. Vesting is not cash unless a sale/settlement pays it.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Keep unknown-year vest values out of dated totals with an explicit incomplete flag; label vesting value separately from bank cash.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Groups by each row's year (right for dated rows), with an undated row under this year (wrong). Its second point, that vesting is not money in the bank until shares are sold, is a NEEDS A RULING item (see needs_a_ruling).
formula_checks.fixed_2026_10_25: FIXED 2026-10-25 (FIX-INCOME-B): each vest counts in the year its date names, read through the one reader of the vests (equityVests, yearMonthOf): rsuAnnual, equityCashFlow, equityVestWeights and taxableByCalendarMonth agree with equityByMonth; 2026 is $8,317.43 in March only; no date is "vest date not entered", in no year and no month. Its second point (vesting is not cash unless sold) RULED by the lead: kept as shares, taxed, in no month's money; sold at vest, it lands (vestsAreCash).

formula_checks.name: equityVestWeights
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Month weights ignore the vesting year and place undated vesting in December. A run-rate allocation is not an actual calendar-year payment schedule.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Specify run-rate versus actual-year scope and refuse unknown dates; use only that year’s dated events for actual cash.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Month weights over every row whatever its year, an undated row in December; the months, the tax and the grid lay the run-rate over these weights.
formula_checks.fixed_2026_10_25: FIXED 2026-10-25 (FIX-INCOME-B): each vest counts in the year its date names, read through the one reader of the vests (equityVests, yearMonthOf): rsuAnnual, equityCashFlow, equityVestWeights and taxableByCalendarMonth agree with equityByMonth; 2026 is $8,317.43 in March only; no date is "vest date not entered", in no year and no month.

formula_checks.name: rsuAnnual
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Distinct nonempty vest years define a run-rate, but the label annual equity/stock vesting can be read as this year’s actual value; gaps and unknown dates need a contract.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Expose run-rate and actual dated annual vesting separately, with unknown-date coverage.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: A run-rate (total ÷ distinct vest years), correctly named in its own header; its callers (MK-CF-F-083, -084, -088, -092, MK-PL-F-031) use it as this year's income. Undated rows count as one year of it.
formula_checks.fixed_2026_10_25: FIXED 2026-10-25 (FIX-INCOME-B): each vest counts in the year its date names, read through the one reader of the vests (equityVests, yearMonthOf): rsuAnnual, equityCashFlow, equityVestWeights and taxableByCalendarMonth agree with equityByMonth; 2026 is $8,317.43 in March only; no date is "vest date not entered", in no year and no month.

formula_checks.name: rentEntryMonthly
formula_checks.reviewer_why: The owner explicitly treats nonnumeric rent as not entered, but returning the other number minus zero can present a complete net despite a missing component.
formula_checks.reviewer_should_be: Retain parsed values and per-field entered flags; refuse an unqualified net when a required component is unentered. Preserve the owner’s strict parser.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: Each figure through the strict reader, a figure not read becoming 0, net = rent − costs.
formula_checks.plain_example: Rent "about 2k", costs $600: net −$600 a month, counted as a $7,200-a-year loss.
formula_checks.fixed_2026_10_25: FIXED 2026-10-25 (FIX-INCOME-B): rent not entered → no net, not counted.

formula_checks.name: rentalList
formula_checks.reviewer_why: Counts only named properties, preserves a rental loss and uses the owner’s strict parser; unentered component metadata must be supplied by the parser/consumer.
formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: The reviewer found it right; its five cases agree with the app.

formula_checks.reviewer_why: Adds net rent including losses and annualizes known monthly amounts; mortgages are outside running costs under the owner ruling.

needs_a_ruling.item: Whether vested shares are money in the bank
needs_a_ruling.reading_a: they land as money in March, $1,000 less the rate (what the app does)
needs_a_ruling.reading_b: $1,000 is taxed income in March but not money to spend until the shares are sold; they sit in Net worth
needs_a_ruling.recommendation: Reading b, with a "sold when they vest" choice that makes them land as money. It is how his DEC-0179 treats reinvested dividends (taxed, not spendable), and tenet 7 (nothing made to look better than it is). DEC-0012 settles the month, not whether it is cash.
